name: NOOP Trainer
subtitle: NOOP with a voice-guided workout coach.
description:
A SideStore / AltStore source for NOOP Trainer, a personal fork of NOOP (https://github.com/ryanbr/noop) that adds a voice-guided Couch to 5K coach. Add this source to get one-tap updates.

Not affiliated with WHOOP or with the NOOP project.

apps.name: NOOP Trainer
apps.subtitle: NOOP plus a voice-guided C25K coach.
apps.localizedDescription:
Everything in NOOP (an offline companion for a WHOOP strap you own), plus a voice-guided Couch to 5K coach: spoken run/walk cues over your music, heart-rate guidance from the strap, and a 9-week progress tracker.

Personal, experimental fork; not affiliated with WHOOP or with the NOOP project. Source: https://github.com/karanadapala/noop-trainer

versions.localizedDescription: First NOOP Trainer release: voice-guided C25K coach with a 9-week progress tracker.
